title: Reproducibility Package: Scientometric Analysis of the Big Earth Data Journal (2017–2026)
description: Self-contained Jupyter notebooks, anonymized aggregated datasets, publication-grade figures, and summary tables supporting the scientometric analysis in "A mixed-methods retrospective and reflective analysis of the Big Earth Data journal" (Mooney & Juhász, Big Earth Data, 10-Year Retrospective Special Issue). Covers all 356 Scopus-indexed items (339 citable publications) published in Big Earth Data from launch in 2017 through August 30, 2026.
